entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say your reason for calling.
Return an item.
Connecting you to an agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return the VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's just not what I expected. My order number is VF58291.
I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order VF58291... Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 12 days ago, is that correct?
I guess? It's been about that long. I just want to send it back. Can you email me a label?

I understand. I'm just checking the return eligibility here... Unfortunately, it looks like the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return window due to the nature of the device. It seems you're two days past that period.
Are you kidding me? Ten days? It took me that long just to find time to set it up! It's two days, that's ridiculous. I want my money back.
I do apologize for the frustration. That policy is highlighted on the product page, but I know things can be easily missed. The system automatically locks returns after the 10-day mark.
I don't care what the system says. This is a brand new device, I barely used it. Are you telling me I'm just stuck with it over two days? I want to speak to a manager.
Let me... let me see what I can do. Please hold on for just a moment... Look, my manager would kill me for even suggesting this, as the policy is very strict.
So you're going to help me or not?
Okay. As a special, one-time exception, I'm going to see if I can manually override the system for you. I'm not supposed to do this, and I can't promise it will work, but I'll try.

Let me just input a few codes here... Okay... It looks like it's going through. I've successfully processed the return authorization. The return label has just been sent to the email address on your account.
Oh! Wow, I just got it. Thank you so much. I was getting really frustrated there. I really appreciate you doing that for me.
You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get that sorted out. Just be sure to pack it in the original box and drop it off within the next week. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Will do. Seriously, thanks again, Alex. You saved me a huge headache.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Nope, that was it. Have a good day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
